showcase: One goal becomes a supervised agent team with per-role model pinning, review loops, machine-checked evidence contracts and a live kanban and flow chart tab in the web GUI.
summary: In-process multi-agent orchestration: architect decomposes a goal into a task DAG, builders run in parallel as subagents, reviewers gate results, an integrator merges, with a duty table pinning models per role and a live web dashboard.
